description: Mutants for the menu of actions in the live launcher. Not listed because equivalent or out of reach: the staleness check of an answer (the gap between asking and the answer is too short to close the window inside it, in a test), and forgetting the menu when closing (opening forgets it too). Not listed because it cannot be provoked in a live shell: a copy that fails (the clipboard always works there); it is covered by the unit tests of the controller. Also not listed because equivalent: the guard on Enter during the confirmation (a field that is not editable does not send Enter at all).
